lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-2.3
lesson_intro.board_text:
Security Groups in Practice
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Wrong SG rules = either outage or open-to-world disaster.

Mental model:
Security Group = stateful allow-list on the ENI. Default deny inbound.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Wrong SG rules = either outage or open-to-world disaster. Mental model: Security Group = stateful allow-list on the ENI. Default deny inbound. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Security Groups in Practice
• Security Group = stateful allow-list on the ENI. Default deny inbound.
• Mistake: 0.0.0.0/0 on SSH 'temporarily'.
• Habit: Source should be another SG or known CIDR — never lazy open.

segments.title: Open VPC
segments.setup_voice: Watch — we open VPC the way a real ticket starts.

steps.voice: Navigate to VPC. Confirm Region ap-south-1 before you trust the empty list.
Security groups live with the network story even when edited near EC2.

segments.lesson_voice: Allow only what the ticket needs. Temporary means ticket with expiry.

check.voice: What does a security group do by default for inbound?
check.response_if_correct: Deny inbound unless you allow — stateful allow-list.
check.response_if_incorrect: Default deny inbound. You add allows carefully.

steps.voice: An L2 opened 22 to the world to 'debug'. Scanners found it in minutes.
